officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Department of Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, Haryana
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official department page describes Jamabandi, mutation, Khasra Girdawari and reports implemented in all 143 tehsils; it is general state agency evidence, not a successful Rewari parcel response.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: National Informatics Centre / Department of Land Resources
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page states Bhu-Naksha is customized and integrated with ROR data for Haryana; it does not expose a public Rewari viewer or anonymous feature endpoint.
